title: TypeScript build floor
decision: A: implemented examples/web-dashboard/src/main.js (Option B, deleting the example, was rejected — it's a documented proof artifact referenced by pnpm-lock.yaml, docs/explanation/breeds_typescript_thesis.md, and CLAUDE.md)
correction_found_during_implementation: the root script interview:wasm:web builds pkg-web to packages/cognition/pkg-web, but examples/web-dashboard/package.json declares its dependency as ../../crates/wasm4pm-cognition/pkg-web — a real path mismatch between two parts of the repo. Built directly to crates/wasm4pm-cognition/pkg-web (the location the example's own package.json already expects) rather than editing the dependency path, since that's the minimal correct fix.

api_verified_before_landing.cognition_run_signature: pub fn cognition_run(input_json: &str) -> Result<JsValue, JsValue> — single JSON string argument, not (breed, input) as an earlier draft assumed
api_verified_before_landing.input_wrapper_shape: { breed: string, contract: BreedInput, options?: { profile } } — field is 'contract', not 'input'; fixture files use {breed, input} so main.js maps fixture.input -> contract
api_verified_before_landing.output_shape_confirmed: {status, breed, run_id, input_hash, output_hash, ocel_hash, wasm_hash, model_hash, replay_pointer, options_profile, output, conformance, signature, public_key_id, signature_algorithm} — no 'kpis' field exists on the real output; main.js derives its KPI display from conformance.fitness/model_id and options_profile instead of a nonexistent kpis object

commands_run.cmd: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web --out-name wasm4pm_cognition --release --features wasm
